sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and on an excellent run of form (W-D-W-W-W), host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Alsager are struggling near the bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 games and have lost their last five matches, making this a golden opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead and maintain their position at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if they can secure victory. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between sides currently occupying 3rd and 5th respectively. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, face Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United—the latter having lost five of their last six matches. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, two mid-table sides seeking wins, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a match between two of the division's struggling teams. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, with Widnes having managed just 2 points from 7 games. Crewe face Allscott Heath in another fixture involving lower-table sides.
